dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Kay, I've brought water and some rations. Later on, we can build a fire and grill some meat.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Hmm? You think we should be safe enough here?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Haha, well yeah, I know! That's why I figured this would be a great place for a picnic. The battles are important, but we should take some time to relax first.
